title: The Garden of Junebug Creek
author: Mara Lockridge
blurb: August Brightwater, a vineyard owner who inherited debts instead of grapes, swears the heart is a muscle like any other: trainable, containable. Then a fake date to survive a family reunion feels too real by dessert — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must choose between the career that saved everything and the person who sees clearly at last, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
